items.docs:
Retrieves a quote for a pay event for a given participant code and asset.
The response includes a deposit address and rate at which a subsequent on-chain deposit will be honored.

The quote has an expiry timestamp (`price_expire_ts`) — for volatile assets, the platform must execute the deposit before this time,
or a new quote can be requested for the same payment to refresh the price.
For stablecoins, `price_expire_ts` will be `null`.

The `request_id` you send (via the `X-Request-Id` header) i

params.name: id
params.description: The transaction ID (UUID) returned from the original POST /pay/rfq call

items.docs:
Refreshes an existing pay quote identified by its transaction ID.
This is used when a previously issued quote is near to expire and the platform wants a new rate for the same deposit address.
Already expired quotes can't be refreshed.

The response format is identical to `POST /pay/rfq` — it returns an updated rate, expiry timestamp, and the same deposit address.

params.name: transaction_id
params.description: Filter by specific transaction ID (UUID format)

params.name: client_reference_id
params.description: Filter by client-provided reference ID. This filter may not be available for all platforms. Contact support if you need access.

params.name: pay_asset
params.description: Filter by the underlying crypto asset (e.g., BTC, ETH, USDC)

params.name: deposit_address
params.description: Filter by the deposit address provided by zerohash for this payment.

params.name: success
params.description: Filters transactions by successful status. This is a boolean field, please specify either `true` or `false`

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results returned per page, with a maximum of 50 transactions per page

params.name: deposit_timestamp_gte
params.description: Deposit timestamp greater than or equal to this value (inclusive). Unix milliseconds (13-19 digits). This filter may not be available for all platforms. Contact support if you need access.

params.name: deposit_timestamp_gt
params.description: Deposit timestamp strictly greater than this value (exclusive). Unix milliseconds (13-19 digits). This filter may not be available for all platforms. Contact support if you need access.

params.name: deposit_timestamp_lt
params.description: Deposit timestamp strictly less than this value (exclusive). Unix milliseconds (13-19 digits). This filter may not be available for all platforms. Contact support if you need access.

params.name: deposit_timestamp_lte
params.description: Deposit timestamp less than or equal to this value (inclusive). Unix milliseconds (13-19 digits). This filter may not be available for all platforms. Contact support if you need access.

items.docs:
Retrieves a paginated list of pay transactions for the authenticated platform.
Results can be filtered by participant, asset, deposit status, and timestamps.
Each deposit also emits a `crypto_pay_status_changed` webhook when it settles or fails.

**Note:** Some filtering capabilities may not be available for all platforms. Contact support if you need access to additional filters.

params.name: merchant_participant_code
params.description: Optional merchant participant code. When supplied, the response also includes `merchant_totals` (volume totals aggregated against that merchant). The authenticated platform must operate for the merchant or the request is rejected.

items.docs:
Retrieves the current authorization level, per-window limits, and volume totals for an
end-user participant on the authenticated platform. Optionally scoped to a specific
merchant when `merchant_participant_code` is supplied (the authenticated platform must
operate for that merchant).

params.name: id
params.description: Transaction id of the manual approval to cancel.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: End-user participant (shopper) code whose approval to cancel.

params.name: merchant_code
params.description: Merchant participant code associated with the approval. Defaults to the authenticated platform code when omitted.

items.docs:
Cancels a pending or approved manual approval for a Tier 4 payin transaction,
setting it to REJECTED state.

Use this endpoint when a platform or shopper wants to withdraw a transaction
that is awaiting compliance review. Once cancelled, the transaction cannot
be reinstated — a new `POST /pay/rfq` must be issued.

The `merchant_code` query parameter is optional. When omitted, the
authenticated platform code is used as the merchant identifier.
